title: Member search never links to a route the menu hides

source.ref: Search coverage scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Make search cover every public item)

detail: The left menu hides /classifieds, /housing, /nearby, /network and /channels (menu_items mode 'hidden', checked in Frequency Community 2026-11-17), but search still offers them: the /search Listings tab reads active Classifieds and links each to /classifieds/<id> (1 live row today), its 'Go to' list (lib/search/destinations.ts) offers /housing and /classifieds/new, and the live search's 'Go to' (paletteDestinations, lib/nav/registry.ts) offers Around You, Members and Channels. Fix: one reader (lib/search/hidden-routes.ts) of the hidden menu rows, fail-closed to that list, applied to both 'Go to' lists and to the Classifieds results; /journeys is exempt by owner ruling 2026-11-17.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
